Bilateral Investment Treaty between Vietnam and Japan (2003)
Bilateral Investment Treaty between Vietnam and South Korea (2003)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (effective 01/03/2023); Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP detailing articles of the AML Law; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Vietnam on AML/CFT; Enterprise Law No. 59/2020/QH14; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decision No. 1728/QD-TTg approving the National AML/CFT Action Plan; SBV regulations on licensing of non-bank lending businesses (Decree 39/2014/ND-CP, Circular 39/2016/TT-NHNN).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Charter / Memorandum and Articles of Association of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry or competent authority of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if country is signatory) OR Consular Legalization by Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national ID copies of all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), directors, and legal representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / notary public of the individual's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization for foreign natural persons; domestic notarization in Vietnam where applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing Vietnamese incorporation service provider and/or legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin or Vietnamese consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration form (ownership structure chart showing legal and natural persons holding 25% or more) certified by the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate secretary / board of directors of the parent company

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Solvency or equivalent official extract of foreign corporate shareholders
Bank reference letter or audited financial statements of shareholders to substantiate source of funds and capital contribution capability
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank or licensed auditor in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization or internationally notarized certification prescribed by Vietnamese authorities

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clear certificate for each natural person acting as legal representative / director / UBO in Vietnam
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Judicial record office / police department of the person's residence or nationality jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization and translation into Vietnamese

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the lists of politically exposed persons (PEPs) per Law 14/2022/QH15 Art. 26; OFAC SDN List; UN Security Council Consolidated List; EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; Vietnam's own list promulgated under SBV Guidance; FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions List; World Bank/IFC exclusion lists; full-name, DOB, passport number, and address rationalization; EDD required for enhanced-risk clients; ongoing transaction monitoring and periodic re-screening at least annually or upon trigger events.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal — Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Business names must be in Vietnamese language with Latin-script letters; foreign-invested enterprises may use Vietnamese uppercase letters, numerals and '&'; foreign company trade names may be transliterated into Vietnamese or kept in foreign script subject to Decree 01/2021/ND-CP Articles 38–48; name must contain enterprise type ('Công ty TNHH' or 'Công ty Trách Nhiệm Hữu Hạn' / 'Công ty Cổ phần' etc.) plus proper name; proper name must be distinguishable from other enterprises; foreign characters are permitted only as part of a foreign name recorded per Art. 41; Vietnamese authorities screen for identical/confusingly similar names; transliteration into local script is required for registration; tone marks allowed.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Ngân hàng (bank) — requires SBV license; prohibited for LLC without license
Bảo hiểm (insurance) — requires Ministry of Finance license
Đầu tư tài chính / Quỹ đầu tư — prior ministerial approval required
Factor / Factoring / Bao thanh toán — subject to SBV licensing conditions
Nhà nước / Chính phủ / Quốc hội / Bộ / Ủy ban — implying state authority (prohibited)
Quân đội / Công an / Quốc phòng / An ninh — sensitive official/security tokens
Tên of national heroes, political figures, or cultural icons — prohibited without authorization
Words violating national sovereignty or public interest, contrary to socialist morality, culture, or customs
Identical or confusingly similar names to existing registered enterprises or protected trademarks
Name includes 'Việt Nam' as proper name unless in shareholder's own registered trademark or with special permission
Terms indicating charity, religion, or professions requiring additional licensing (e.g., 'Luật sư', 'Dược') unless qualified
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name reservation is rejected, applicant may within 10 working days from date of rejection file an administrative appeal to the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment where the enterprise is registering; alternatively, re-submit a modified name application through the National Business Registration Portal; if rejection is based on substantive grounds, the enterprise may initiate an administrative lawsuit at the competent People's Court under the Law on Administrative Procedures; appeal must include original name clearance request, rejection notice, legal analysis rebutting grounds, and proof of compliance; DPI must respond within 15 working days per administrative procedures law; second-level appeal to the Ministry of Planning and Investment if first-level appeal fails.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office / no physical premises is NOT permissible for a factoring and trade finance enterprise; commercial substance requirements mandated by credit institutions and non-bank lending licensing rules; a dedicated physical office at a fixed address in Vietnam within DPI territory is mandatory; serviced office/single-desk arrangements may be acceptable during pre-licensing but full physical presence and personnel are required prior to operation; virtual mail forwarding services alone do not satisfy the registered-office mandate under Law on Enterprises Art. 43.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High likelihood (quantified at 70-80% for licensed financial service providers): State Bank of Vietnam, DPI, tax authorities, and police economic security divisions routinely perform unannounced inspections within the first 12 months of licensing; trade financing companies face enhanced supervisory on-site audits due to medium-risk AML/CFT classification; physical document production and UBO registry verification are standard inspection triggers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) / National Business Registration Portal service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; statutory filing is low; professional search fee included

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Vietnamese incorporation documents (charter, IRC application, ERC application, UBO declarations) at local notary office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vietnam Notary Public Office (Phòng Công Chứng)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff per Circular 257/2016/TT-BTC and market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Enterprise Registration (ERC) issuance and receipt — government fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No government fee per Law on Enterprise Fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) processing for foreign-invested LLC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative fee per Decree 01/2021/ND-CP; minimal statutory amount

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization / apostille of foreign shareholder documents, passports, police certificates, and POA at Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate or MOFA
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vietnamese Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Consular Department) / Embassy / Consulate and foreign competent apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular tariff per Circular 12/2019/TT-BNG; market courier and coordinating fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of legalized foreign documents into Vietnamese by recognized translation office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed translation/certification service provider in Vietnam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per page/individual language pairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO identification and screening software/database access (PEP, OFAC, UN, FATF, domestic sanctions lists)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Refinitiv / Dow Jones / local Vietnamese AML screening vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark annual license per entity / user

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensing feasibility assessment and pre-consultation with State Bank of Vietnam (if factoring is regarded as non-credit financial service requiring SBV license)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; government pre-consultation is informal/free

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Lessor / commercial real estate agent / legal due diligence provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for feasibility, landlord consent letter, and verification fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal professional fees for entity structuring, drafting charter, investment project proposal, and compliance with foreign-investment conditions

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Enterprise Law 2020), Articles 22–28 (Enterprise Registration), Articles 46–47 (Company Charter), Articles 54–57 (Limited Liability Company governance), Article 74 (Rights and obligations of members), read together with Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration and Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT on forms.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: National Business Registration Portal (NBRP) operated by the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment; provincial Departments of Planning and Investment (DPIs) acting as Business Registration Offices.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) with accompanying Company Charter, List of Members, and supporting legal documents prescribed by Decree 01/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC under the Enterprise Law 2020 unless subject to special conditions (e.g., licensed factoring, collection services under SBV supervision). A foreign-invested trade/factoring LLC should submit a capital commitment possibly subject to SBV licensing thresholds for non-bank credit institutions. Escrow account or bank-confirmed capital contribution arrangement is recommended but not mandatory under the Enterprise Law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE MEMBERS' COUNCIL OF [COMPANY NAME], a Vietnamese Limited Liability Company established under Law No. 59/2020/QH14. ADOPTED in writing by unanimous consent of all members/contributors on [DATE]. RESOLVED: 1. Share Capital Subscription and Contribution: all members subscribe to the authorised capital as stated in the Company Charter, and the General Director is directed to open an escrow/capital contribution account with a licensed commercial bank and transfer the subscribed capital within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate being issued; capital may be held in escrow pending statutory licensing where required. 2. Registered Office: the registered office located at [address] in Viet Nam is confirmed as the legal seat of the Company for service of process and official notices; the General Director is authorised to execute and file the required lease documentation and office acceptance protocol. 3. Officer Appointments: the following natural persons are appointed to the offices shown: (a) [Name] as Chair of the Members' Council / Managing Member; (b) [Name] as General Director/CEO with sole and joint signatory authority; (c) [Name] as Chief Accountant; and (d) [Name] as Compliance Officer and Anti-Money Laundering Officer for the trade-finance/factoring line of business. AUTHORITY: The General Director (or Co-Chairs where so resolved) is/are authorised to complete all regulatory filings, licensing applications, and to open Swift-wire and escrow bank accounts; any one signatory acting with the Compliance Officer may execute client agreements. EFFECTIVE: Immediately upon adoption and to be filed with the Company Charter as part of the statutory corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Approval and Company Charter Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (NBRP) via provincial DPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a preliminary name reservation and verification through the NBRP; ensure the company name does not duplicate or conflict with existing registered names and complies with Articles 38–40 of the Enterprise Law 2020. Draft the Company Charter in Vietnamese with at least the mandatory statutory contents under Article 46 of the Enterprise Law, including capital structure, member list, legal representative, and scope of business.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a corrected name proposal through the NBRP within 10 working days; or submit an administrative appeal to the DPI.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation foreign investment registration and capital contribution arrangement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial DPI under the Investment Law 2020, or the board of management of industrial/export processing zones; SBV for licensing threshold confirmation if relevant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) if the project requires approval under Article 30 of the Investment Law 2020; an escrow account at a licensed Vietnamese bank may be opened by foreign investors to evidence capital availability, especially for wire-transfer and trade-finance activities. Submit the IRC application with legalised/notarised constitutional documents and proof of willingness to sustain a trade-finance operation.
required_dossiers: Passport / corporate documents of foreign investors
Proof of escrow capital deposit or bank commitment letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues comments, amend the application within 7 working days; if refusal occurs, reinstate through a new application or appeal to the provincial People's Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Enterprise Registration Application for LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office under the provincial DPI via NBRP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Application for Enterprise Registration, Company Charter, and List of Members through the NBRP or direct submission to the DPI. Obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate and automatically issued tax code. The state fee is nil for the electronic application; payments for publishing registration details may apply.
required_dossiers: List of members and capital contribution schedule
ID/citizen certificate or passport of legal representative
Lease agreement or title deed for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, correct the dossier and resubmit within 10 working days; if formally refused, appeal to the provincial DPI or file with the administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation filings, seal making, tax and labor registration status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial DPI, provincial Tax Department (via General Department of Taxation), Social Insurance Agency, and licensed seal engraving enterprise
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create a company seal and file the seal specimen certificate with the DPI within the prescribed time; submit the registration post-posting of the charter and enterprise registration publication on NBRP; open a corporate account with a licensed Vietnamese bank for escrow/Swift wire settlement; complete VAT and corporate income tax registration (Form 01-ĐK-TCT); register employees for social insurance via the electronic submission system.
required_dossiers: Social insurance and labor-related registration for the first employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax code is delayed, follow up with the tax office; if seal certificate is delayed, use provisional seal until formal certificate issued; late publications may be cured by payment of late fees and proof of amendment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) for factoring/credit extension licensing under Law on Credit Institutions; Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) for non-financial trade/back-office activities; local DPI for additional business line registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: License to Perform Non-Bank Credit Institution Activities or Operation License for Factoring/Receivable Purchase Services, or an SBV no-objection/legal confirmation where factoring is performed as a commercial auxiliary service; otherwise the Official Industry and Trade Service Registration Certificate (under MOIT/DOIT) for domestic trade services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) / provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) under Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree 08/2022/ND-CP.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III – Environmental Impact Assessment not required for a professional office/trade-finance service operator if the premises produce no industrial wastewater or hazardous emissions; however, an Environmental Permit may be required if IT and cooling infrastructure creates hazardous waste streams or wastewater discharge; otherwise, registration as an exempt establishment is standard.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with QCVN 40:2011/BTNMT for any wastewater discharge (BOD5≤30mg/L, COD≤50mg/L, TSS≤50mg/L) where connected to municipal sewer; compliance with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT and QCVN 20:2009/BTNMT for any standby generator exhaust; waste handling under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP with certificates for hazardous waste from spent toner/backup batteries/electronic equipment to an authorised handler.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Prevention and Fighting Certification from the local Fire Police (typically a Fire Safety Same-Day Certificate for office area under 5,000 m²); civil defense and structural load inspection certificate from the provincial construction authority for the leased premises; occupational safety and hygiene inspection under Law No. 84/2015/QH13; occupational health clearance and employee safety statement as applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế, GDT) under the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam; electronic administration is centralized on the eTax portal at https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn and the national e-invoice portal at https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; customs-side VAT and export declarations are administered by the General Department of Viet Nam Customs under the Ministry of Finance via the VNACCS/VCIS e-clearance system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 - file an Investment Registration Certificate application with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) or the Export Processing and Industrial Zone Authority; no statutory minimum capital applies to the LLC, but the project and factoring/credit-extension authority must be expressly included in the investment objective. Step 2 - file enterprise registration with the same DPI under the Enterprise Law 2020; upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, the National Enterprise Registration Database automatically allocates the permanent 13-digit Tax Identification Number (MST), so no separate GDT application is required at incorporation. Step 3 - complete tax registration activation at the sub-department of taxation by filing the GDT e-form 01-DK-TCT on eTax, uploading the IRC, ERC, and legal representative identification; the tax office activates the MST for VAT, CIT, license fee (LPT) and PIT-withholding accounts. Step 4 - register the e-invoice template and bank account number(s) with the GDT, obtain a digital signature certificate from an accredited CA for e-invoicing, and register optional customs-clearance broker mandates. A foreign contractor carrying on business in Viet Nam without a PE uses a separate registration code under the FCT regime rather than an MST.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: a foreign-invested LLC is a resident corporate taxpayer subject to CIT at 20% on worldwide net business income computed under the Enterprise Law and CIT Law 2018-recodified; there is no pass-through of income or losses to foreign shareholders; dividends and interest remittances to foreign shareholders are additionally subject to a 5% tax on dividend distributions (offset mechanism for dividends paid from after-tax profit) and other WHT only on cross-border payments. Territorial scope: income arising in Viet Nam is taxable; foreign-source income is taxable in full with a foreign tax credit capped at the Vietnamese CIT amount on that income. Losses may be carried forward up to 5 years. A factoring entity within the credit-institution scope remains a CIT taxpayer at 20%.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not have a check-the-box classification regime; entity classification is hardwired under the Law on Enterprises. The principal elective mechanisms available are: (i) filing an application with the DPI for CIT incentive eligibility (high-technology, supporting industry, large-scale industrial projects, socialized sectors, or zone-based incentives) that triggers a preferential 10% or 15% rate, tax holidays of up to 4 years and 50% rate reductions of up to 9 years; (ii) the irrevocable election, upon satisfying accounting and revenue tests, between the VAT credit method and the direct method; (iii) for inbound cross-border service suppliers without a PE, the deemed Foreign Contractor Tax method (VAT deemed and CIT deemed assessed on gross receipts) versus a tax-permanent-establishment computation; (iv) requesting an advance tax ruling from the GDT under Article 41 of the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14 for novel factoring structures; (v) applying the qualified domestic minimum top-up tax at 15% for constituent entities of MNEs in scope of Resolution 107/2023/QH15; (vi) no hybrid or check-the-box elections exist, and anti-hybrid/mismatch rules are enforced under general anti-avoidance, CFC rules and BEPS-aligned transfer-pricing decrees (Decree 132/2020/ND-CP).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng) administered under the VAT Law No. 13/2008/QH12 as amended by Law No. 31/2013/QH13 and Law No. 71/2014/QH13, implemented by Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC and Circular No. 80/2021/TT-BTC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1,000,000,000 (one billion Vietnamese Dong) of annual revenue from VAT-liable goods and services in the preceding twelve months is the mandatory full VAT registration threshold (Article 5 Decree 209/2013/ND-CP; Article 1 Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC). Businesses below the threshold may voluntarily register; a taxpayer whose activity consists exclusively of VAT-exempt revenue (e.g., pure factoring credit services by a licensed non-bank credit institution) is not required to register unless it also carries on VAT-liable activities. Foreign contractors in Vietnam are registered for deemed VAT assessment regardless of revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing for all enterprises effective 1 July 2022 (Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC). Every VAT invoice must be generated through the GDT-approved e-invoice format, digitally signed with a business digital certificate, and transmitted in near-real-time to the GDT national e-invoice portal (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn). The tax authority validates the file and, for the class of taxpayers subject to the authentication-code regime, returns a 12-digit digital authentication code affixed to the invoice as a condition of lawfulness; taxpayers meeting transparency conditions may use the self-authentication method. There is no physical fiscal stamping; the GDT publishes structured JSON/XML API specifications for software suppliers, and import-VAT clearance runs through the VNACCS customs platform. Non-transmission of invoice data to the GDT within the statutory deadline triggers invoice-use suspension and administrative fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP (up to VND 20 million for late transmission; up to VND 40 million for illegal invoices). Cash-sale outlets must issue e-invoices per invoice at the point of sale.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate is available only where the goods are physically exported from Viet Nam under a customs export declaration and the payment is remitted in a freely convertible currency (or in VND accepted for cross-border trade), and where the sale is recorded under an export contract and commercial invoice. For export services (including revenue from the target trade-finance/factoring scope), 0% VAT applies where the service is supplied to a foreign organization or individual with no establishment in Viet Nam and the service is consumed entirely outside Vietnamese territory; commission and factoring fee income earned by a Vietnamese LLC from a non-resident bank or factor to finance an overseas seller-buyer chain may qualify as export services if the beneficial consumption test is met, while pure credit extension (interest and discounts) remains VAT-exempt rather than zero-rated. The zero-rating claim requires a complete substantiation file evidencing the offshore character of the service and the non-resident status of the counterparty. Input VAT on costs attributable to zero-rated exports is fully creditable and, if not offset, is refundable in cash under Articles 71-72 of the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14 and Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC, subject to the statutory refund pre-audit for newly established exporters in their first 12 months.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai Hải quan) conclusively cleared by the General Department of Viet Nam Customs (including electronic clearance message from VNACCS)
Signed export contract or Sales Agreement evidencing Incoterms, parties, description, quantity and price
Commercial invoice and packing list issued by the exporting LLC
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, or Air Waybill showing the discharge port and consignee outside Viet Nam

Bank payment dossier: SWIFT MT103, inward foreign-currency remittance certificate, or a telegraphic-transfer credit advice from the VN servicing bank proving funds inbound within the statutory deadline
Certificate of Origin (C/O) where preferential origin is claimed or customs requires it

For export services: offshore consumption dossier including the foreign customer’s certificate of tax residence or registry extract, the service delivery report, underlying trade documents in a reverse-factoring chain, and evidence that the service benefit was realized outside Viet Nam
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT performs desk and field audits that reconcile e-invoice data, customs declarations, bank remittances and CIT/VAT returns. Any refund claimed on fraudulent or fabricated exports is clawed back for the entire refunded amount, plus late payment interest at 0.03% per day from the date the refund was credited, plus a penalty of up to 100% of the understated or evaded tax amount (tiers 20%, 30%, 40%, 60% and 100% set out in Article 16 of Decree 125/2020/ND-CP). Where a taxpayer knowingly issues or uses illegal e-invoices to substantiate zero-rating, the illegally issued invoice fine can reach VND 40,000,000, the invoice use is suspended for 1-3 months, and the VAT refund claim is barred for up to 12 months. Repeated or large-scale schemes transit into criminal liability under the Penal Code 2015/2017: Article 200 (tax evasion) permits imprisonment of up to 10 years (severe tier) and disqualification or suspension of the LLC's tax-relevant activities; Article 188 (smuggling) and Article 221 (false accounting) carry imprisonment of up to 15 years and confiscation of assets. Corporate fines and suspension of tax registration numbers are imposed in addition to personal criminal liability. Directors, CFOs and compliance officers of the Vietnamese LLC may personally be held criminally liable; mitigating evidence includes voluntary self-declaration under Article 148 of the Law on Tax Administration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam); the Foreign Exchange Administration Department under the SBV exercises day-to-day FX control, with the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) and the General Department of Vietnam Customs (GDVC) coordinating on investment capital and export-import trade data.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam maintains a managed floating exchange-rate regime. Current-account transactions (trade in goods, services, interest, fees) are generally convertible, subject to documentary review by an authorized bank. Capital-account transactions remain restricted and require registration or prior approval: direct share capital contributions, foreign loans, and security issuance must be registered with the SBV or an authorized bank as a Capital Account (Form 03/NHNN for loans). Profit remittance is permitted under current-account treatment: a foreign-invested enterprise may remit annual profits abroad after the audited financial statements are approved, corporate income tax is fully settled, all statutory reserve requirements are satisfied, and a profit-distribution resolution is passed by the members' meeting; remittance is made through an authorized bank using the 'profit remittance abroad' purpose code. Dividends and interest on shareholder loans are subject to tax-finalization checks and bank-level AML review. Legal capital must be fully contributed within 90 days (modified by IRC timeline) and certified by the bank before credit facilities are fully utilized. The Vietnamese dong (VND) is not fully convertible for speculative capital purposes; NDF trading domestically is not permitted for residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SBV regulations (principally Circular 05/2021/TT-NHNN and the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange), exporters must repatriate export proceeds into Vietnam within 90 days from the date of export (extendable with SBV approval in case of force majeure or letters of credit tenor). Unless the exporter is an Export Processing Enterprise (EPE) or has obtained an SBV retention approval, export proceeds are subject to mandatory sale to an authorized commercial bank: at present, export receipts must be converted into VND or held under an approved foreign-currency account with a fixed retention period (typically up to 180 days extendable). The 30% mandatory conversion ratio has been effectively suspended; however, authorized banks are instructed to ensure exporters sell their receipts to meet VND obligations and to comply with each bank's internal surrender/conversion policy. For a factoring entity, the underlying exporter's repatriation and conversion obligation remains a compliance condition precedent: the factor must obtain evidence of the exporter's FX surrender/conversion certificate and assign the export proceeds to the factoring company via an irrevocable assignment notice accepted by the importer. The 90-day timeline runs from the customs export clearance date unless the trade agreement has a longer credit period approved by the bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.domestic_currency_transaction_principles: Under Article 4 of the Foreign Exchange Ordinance, all domestic transactions in Vietnam must be denominated and settled in VND, with narrow exceptions for transactions between authorized credit institutions, foreign-invested enterprises with SBV approval, EPEs, and certain non-resident counterparties. Factoring advances to domestic suppliers must be disbursed in VND unless the factoring receivables are denominated in foreign currency from approved export contract proceeds. Domestic collection from Vietnamese obligors must be in VND; foreign currency collection is permissible only for receivables sourced from non-residents under permitted transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.annual_profit_remittance_liquidity_windo: Profits may be remitted once annually, normally after the annual general meeting/corporate decision on dividend distribution, within 60 days from the approval of the audited financial statements. The remitting bank will require: audited financial statements, tax finalization certificate from the tax authority (or evidence that all tax obligations are settled), minutes of the members' meeting approving distribution, audited statement of undistributed profits, and confirmation that no overdue debts to the SBV exist. The remitter must complete a Foreign Exchange Declaration form (via the bank's electronic portal) and the bank will apply the prevailing interbank exchange rate for conversion of VND profits into USD/EUR if the company does not retain foreign currency.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. Offshore digital EMI platforms (e.g., Airwallex, Rapyd, Currencycloud, Revolut Business, MultiPass) cannot act as the primary account bank for a Vietnamese entity because they lack SBBank/SBV payment-service licenses in Vietnam. An offshore EMI may be used by the offshore parent or foreign factoring counterparty as an upstream collection/payment vehicle, but it cannot lawfully open a VND/USD account for the local LLC in the LLC's own name. Cross-border funding must ultimately clear through a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank with an SBV-approved capital account. Certain EMIs offer white-label multi-currency IBANs that can improve treasury visibility, but they are not a substitute for local bank onboarding; recommendations: (i) use licensed tier-1 domestic bank for statutory accounts; (ii) consider an EMI as an ancillary foreign-currency concentration vehicle outside Vietnam for offshore proceeds, subject to controlled foreign account reporting and tax transparency; (iii) do not route domestic supplier payments through an unlicensed EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Full remote onboarding is generally not accepted for a new foreign-invested LLC. Authorized Vietnamese banks require at least one physical meeting with the ultimate legal representative or a high-level authorized signatory at the bank's head office or a major branch, especially for non-resident directors and for a financial-services category entity. The general director or an appointed local deputy with notarized investment/enterprise documents must appear personally with original passports, entry stamps, investment registration certificate (IRC), enterprise registration certificate (ERC), charter, and beneficial ownership declaration. The bank will conduct a face-to-face CDD interview to verify the business purpose, source of funding, and AML/CTF awareness. However, once the corporate KYC is completed and the entity is onboarded, day-to-day operations and signature execution may be conducted by remittance instruction with dual authorization remotely, using registered tokens/chips. At least one in-country signatory is mandatory to meet the 'physical presence in Vietnam' requirement for opening and maintaining a corporate account; where all signatories are foreign, a physical interview is unavoidable and the bank will apply enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business model flagged as 'high-risk financial service' (factoring) without explicit SBV licensing confirmation or permissible in-house factoring characterization.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence File: (i) SBV written response or regulatory comfort confirming classification of the entity's factoring activities as 'buying and selling of trade receivables' or a licensed financial service; (ii) legal opinion from Vietnamese counsel on whether a license is required under Decree 39/2014/ND-CP and Law on Credit Institutions; (iii) policies and procedures manual for receivables purchase, credit limits, and source-of-fund verification; (iv) risk assessment paper prepared under Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN (AML/CFT requirements); (v) compliance officer appointment resolution; (vi) training records of staff in AML/factoring red flags.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex offshore shareholder chain or beneficial owner located in a jurisdiction with low transparency (e.g., BVI, Seychelles, Hong Kong finance vehicles).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence File: (i) Corporate registry extracts and good-standing certificates for every entity in the ownership chain; (ii) notarized UBO declarations with passport copies; (iii) ownership chart identifying all persons holding 25% or greater; (iv) bank references from the shareholder's primary bank outside Vietnam; (v) professional background/referee letters from recognized lawyers/accountants; (vi) source-of-wealth statements for each ultimate beneficial owner; (vii) CRS/FATCA self-certification forms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contribution funded by third-party remittances or high-volume small transfers inconsistent with stated share capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence File: (i) Capital contribution schedule appended to the IRC; (ii) bank statements showing each shareholder remitting from the shareholder's own account with proper purpose codes; (iii) notarized statutory declaration of source of funds; (iv) loan agreements if the shareholder's equity is funded by a shareholder loan, with SBV loan registration; (v) accounting records evidencing no commingling of capital proceeds; (vi) statement of compliance with Circular 05/2021/TT-NHNN on FX declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Factoring transactions produce fast incoming/outgoing flows that resemble 'pass-through' or shadow payment activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence File: (i) Master factoring agreement with detailed purchase criteria, advance rates, discounting, and collection procedures; (ii) invoice-eligibility checklist showing real economy underlying trades; (iii) sample batch file matching assigned invoices to supplier names, amounts, and trade contracts; (iv) evidence of delivery and acceptance for purchases (e.g., bills of lading, warehouse receipts, POD signatures); (v) audit trail of bank statements mapped to each factoring disbursement and collection; (vi) letter of assignment/notice to each debtor; (vii) an outside accounting firm's agreed-upon procedures report on the trial balance and factoring ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No physical office or employees in Vietnam beyond the registered address (shell-presence risk).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence File: (i) Executed lease agreement for office premises and proof of rent payments; (ii) photographs of the office layout with signage; (iii) labor contract or nominee/resident staff registration with the compulsory social insurance confirmation; (iv) utility bills under the entity's name; (v) org chart with local legal representative and resident supervisor; (vi) board resolution designating Vietnam as the management/back-office center; (vii) proof of domain/website operations originating from Vietnam.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or politically exposed persons (PEP) screening flags on counterparties in the receivables portfolio.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence File: (i) Compliance screening policy and actual screenings run on each debtor/supplier; (ii) international sanctions list search results (UN, OFAC, EU, UK) with dates and search references; (iii) PEP risk assessment and, if applicable, senior-management approved business rationale for higher-risk counterparties; (iv) no-transaction commitment with offshore sanctioned jurisdictions; (v) contractual representations from debtors that they are not sanctioned persons; (vi) independent country-risks assessment brief.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital contributions must be remitted via international wire (SWIFT MT103) from the investor's own bank account to the LLC's Capital Contribution Account at a licensed Vietnamese bank, with the remittance purpose code (e.g., 'Investment capital — direct equity contribution') and the LLC's IRC number. The receiving bank verifies the transfer against the registered capital contribution schedule. If proceeds exceed the registered schedule, the surplus is returned or requires amendment of the IRC. Non-resident shareholders may contribute in VND only from foreign-currency conversion at an authorized bank inside Vietnam; commonly, contributions are made USD to a VND-denominated contribution account and converted at the SBV reference rate. For trade-financing entities, there is a strong recommendation to notify the bank with a Board Resolution and a funds-flow memo. No cross-border contribution into the operating account is permitted without first passing through the capital account; intercompany loans must be registered with the SBV under Circular 12/2022/TT-NHNN if the lender is a foreign credit institution or foreign enterprise.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For disbursed factoring consideration to domestic suppliers: use domestic NAPAS or interbank clearing in VND; ensure the underlying invoice and assignment are documented. For supplier payments in foreign currency to non-resident suppliers (reverse-factoring imports): use SWIFT MT103 with a valid purpose code (e.g., 'payment for imported goods/services'), attaching a pro-forma invoice, trade contract, and, where applicable, customs declaration. For profit remittances: SWIFT MT101/MT103 under the purpose code for profit distribution, with an audited tax-compliance pack. For foreign-loan principal and interest payments: must first be registered as a corporate loan with the SBV through the lending bank; each drawdown and repayment must use the loan registration code and be tracked in the FX position. Commercial LC opening is permitted from the factoring entity only if its licensed scope includes issuance of guarantees or trade credit instruments; otherwise, only the underlying exporters/buyers may open LCs for the trade, with the factor being a beneficiary or an 'invoice financer' receiving proceeds under an ERP/assignment notification.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contracts with a licensed bank for justifiable commercial transactions (delivery on maturity), with a maximum tenor of 365 days, and restricted to genuine underlying exposure
FX swaps between VND and USD with licensed credit institutions, used to manage short-term liquidity mismatches in the factoring funding cycle
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for longer-term USD funding versus VND income streams, subject to SBV derivative licensing and underlying debt documentation
Currency options purchased (caps/floors) for known cash flows; writing uncovered options is generally prohibited for domestic corporates without credit-institution counterparty approval

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs): not generally permitted onshore for residents except via authorized banks with SBV-specific product registration and the presence of a genuine offshore exposure; the entity may instead replicate NDF economics using a forward-plus-deposit/collateral structure or hedge offshore at parent level, but the VND leg must reflect actual cash flows
Commodity-linked or trade-flow-based structured forwards linked to specific export/import invoices
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.liquidity_clearing_rails_summary: Inbound rail: international USD wire → receiving bank's SWIFT network → VND conversion → local bank credit to supplier accounts (via NAPAS or direct internal transfer). Outbound rail: VND debits to suppliers using local clearing; USD payments to foreign funds via MT103 with full purpose-code compliance. For high-velocity factoring, implement a 'collection concentration account' at the main bank with zero-balancing to the operating account, and reconcile factoring receipts daily against assignment registers; maintain VND/USD current account buffers at a level authorized by the SBV for permitted retention.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.capital_and_fx_compliance_operating_note: (i) All foreign borrowings (including intercompany funding carrying interest or principal repayment) require the borrower to obtain a loan registration number from the SBV prior to drawdown for loans with tenor above one year and outstanding principal exceeding VND 10 trillion-equivalent (or thresholds updated by circulars); (ii) for factoring warehousing, the entity must demonstrate that funds are advanced against eligible receivables and are not deposits; (iii) banks are required to report large-value transactions (above VND 300 million or USD equivalent) to the SBV under the AML decree; (iv) the entity must maintain a FX Position Report and submit it to the SBV through the service bank when the aggregate balances at all banks exceed an unspecified threshold; (v) hedge documentation must reference the pure commercial exposure, and hedge effectiveness must be documented by an internal or external financial officer; (vi) the LLC should never rely on cash loans from domestic parties other than licensed banks and licensed finance companies, as private lending outside the credit-institution law is unenforceable and triggers automatic AML reporting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.trade_finance_factoring_compliance_bridg: The factoring entity's eligibility to collect export proceeds directly in foreign currency is conditioned on: (i) the entity holding a valid IRC/ERC permitting financial services or factoring; (ii) the entity maintaining a foreign-currency account at a licensed bank; (iii) the exporter executing an irrevocable assignment of export receivables and notifying the foreign importer; (iv) the SBV/authorized bank accepting the assignment under the decentralization mechanism for export proceeds; (v) reconciliation with customs declarations for the corresponding exports. Where the structure involves cross-border reverse factoring (import financing), the factor's payment to a foreign supplier is an import-cover payment; the Vietnamese buyer remains liable for customs duties and import taxes, and the LC/guarantee must identify the underlying Vietnamese buyer as the account party. These rails ensure the entire treasury operation runs inside SBV consent and is 'bankable' with tier-1 institutions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp) under Article 35, Law on Enterprises 2020
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 (within 90 days from the end of the calendar fiscal year, January 1 – December 31)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 2,000,000 – 3,000,000 (USD 78 – 118) per violation under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; failure to file for three consecutive years triggers forced strike-off and administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee Payment and Declaration (Lệ phí môn bài), Form 01/MBAI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before January 30 of each operating year; newly established enterprises are exempt for their first year of operation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on the unpaid amount; administrative penalties up to VND 40,000,000 (USD 1,550); delinquency beyond 90 days triggers tax debt coercion including garnishment and suspension of invoice use or business operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính đã kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment, Provincial Tax Department, and State Bank of Vietnam (for licensed factoring / non-bank credit institution activity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year end (March 31 for calendar-year enterprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of VND 20,000,000 – 50,000,000 (USD 780 – 1,950) for operating without a statutory audit under Decree 17/2012/ND-CP; late or non-submission of audited statements separately sanctioned; persistent non-compliance by a licensed factoring entity risks suspension or revocation of the State Bank of Vietnam license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Activity Report (Báo cáo hoạt động đầu tư) under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment or Industrial Zone / Export Processing Zone Authority with investment registration jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of the year following the reporting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of VND 10,000,000 – 30,000,000 (USD 390 – 1,170) under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; repeated non-filing can lead to revocation of the Investment Registration Certificate and loss of investment incentives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Form 02/QTT-TNDN) and related schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via the managing Provincial Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the 90th day from fiscal year end (March 31 for calendar-year enterprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties of VND 2,000,000 – 5,000,000 (USD 78 – 195) under the Law on Tax Administration; late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on any underpaid CIT; willful misstatement constitutes tax evasion with criminal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Prudential and Statistical Submissions to the State Bank of Vietnam (non-bank credit institution reporting regime)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Banking Supervision Agency, State Bank of Vietnam (SBV)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual prudential reports filed within 90 days of fiscal year end under SBV Circular 49/2014/TT-NHNN; monthly and quarterly statistical schedules per separate SBV circulars
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative monetary sanctions under Decree 88/2019/ND-CP as amended by Decree 92/2022/ND-CP, with fines up to VND 2,000,000,000 for serious violations; recurring non-reporting constitutes grounds for SBV to restrict operations or withdraw the factoring license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit is mandatory for all foreign-invested enterprises in Viet Nam regardless of size (Decree 17/2012/ND-CP), and for all licensed non-bank credit institutions (including factoring companies) supervised by the State Bank of Vietnam; domestic non-licensed enterprises engage an auditor only where they meet the medium- or large-size classification under Decree 174/2016/ND-CP.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and the Uniform Chart of Accounts under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC, as amended; licensed factoring institutions also comply with SBV accounting and prudential reporting requirements under Circular 49/2014/TT-NHNN; IFRS may be used only for internal consolidation or licensed international reporting and never for statutory filings to the DPI, tax authorities or SBV.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Viet Nam does not operate a public or annual UBO register filing. Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022 (effective June 1, 2023) and Decree 78/2023/ND-CP, the LLC must identify and record beneficial owners holding, directly or indirectly, 25% or more of charter capital or exercising control, keep these records internally updated, and present them to the State Bank of Vietnam, tax authorities, or inspectors on demand; any member/shareholding transfer must be recorded in statutory registers and notified to the Business Registration Office within 10 days of the transaction, with the updated ownership composition reflected in the annual enterprise report due by March 31.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Danh sách thành viên) with capital contributions and ownership percentages
Register of Directors and Legal Representatives (Sổ quản lý giám đốc và người đại diện theo pháp luật)
Minute Book (Sổ biên bản họp Hội đồng thành viên) and Resolution Book
Register of Company Seal and Authorized Signatories
Register of Internal Control, Audit and Risk Committee meetings (SBV-licensed factoring operations)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 200 – 500 per year for professional registered office and corporate secretarial services in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 – 10,000 per year for a licensed foreign-invested factoring company with SBV audit classification; a smaller trading LLC generally ranges USD 1,500 – 4,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard Vietnamese corporate income tax rate is 20%. Preferential regimes include 10% for 15 years for qualified high-tech, software, clean energy, large-scale manufacturing and selected special economic zones; 17% for certain industrial and service projects; and socialised sectors at 15%. Tax holidays commonly grant 4 years of exemption and 9 years of 50% reduction for eligible incentivised projects. Factoring and trade-finance activities under ISIC 6492 are generally standard-rate unless the entity operates from a qualifying SEZ or high-technology zone and satisfies activity conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/TNDN – Annual CIT finalisation return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN), filed electronically through the eTax Portal of the General Department of Taxation at thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn. Quarterly provisional CIT declarations are submitted on Form 01/TNDN, together with advance CIT payments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalisation with quarterly provisional declarations and advance payments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual finalisation return must be filed no later than 90 days after the end of the fiscal year (31 March for a 31 December year-end). Quarterly provisional returns and advance payments are due within 30 days after each quarterly period. If total quarterly advances are less than 80% of the final annual CIT liability, late-payment interest applies to the shortfall.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue from supply of factoring, reverse factoring, discounting, commission and ancillary trade-finance services, net of output VAT and inclusive of accrued fee income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholder should reconcile this line with the full accrual accounting records of the Vietnamese LLC and verify that all Vietnam-source service revenue is included.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: employee costs, IT and office costs, legal and professional fees, financing costs and provisions for doubtful receivables supported by valid invoices and legal evidence of business purpose.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest and royalties payable to foreign related parties must be arm's length, properly documented, and subject to Foreign Contractor Tax absent treaty relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible expenses: administrative fines, penalties, personal expenses, invoices lacking legal validity, depreciation on ineligible assets, and net interest expense exceeding 30% of EBITDA under the thin-capitalisation rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign lender/affiliate must evidence beneficial ownership and tax residency if treaty relief is claimed; disallowed related-party interest is added back to taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income: total revenue less deductible expenses plus other taxable income such as late-payment charges, indemnities and foreign-exchange gains, reduced by the permitted tax-loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent must ensure that interest income earned by the Vietnamese entity on any shareholder loan is separately declared and that no offshore loss is used to reduce Vietnamese tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward utilised: current-year taxable income offset by accumulated tax losses brought forward; maximum carryforward period is five years and carryback is not permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of the Vietnamese LLC may not be consolidated with or used to shelter the foreign shareholder's profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable CIT rate: 20% standard rate, or 10%/15%/17% if the entity qualifies for statutory incentives and holds a valid application/approval issued by the tax authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-invested factoring LLC should not self-apply a preferential rate without written confirmation from the General Department of Taxation; underpayment will be penalised.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable for the fiscal year: taxable income multiplied by the applicable CIT rate, after deducting investment credits and any approved tax incentives.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declared final CIT is the definitive national tax liability of the Vietnamese LLC; corporate-level dividends paid from this after-tax profit are free of further dividend withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total quarterly provisional CIT paid using Form 01/TNDN: the sum of all four quarterly advance payments made during the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders should preserve SWIFT and bank payment evidence for audited financial statements and profit remittance documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due or refund: final annual CIT payable minus total quarterly CIT advances. If a refund is claimed, supporting documents must be submitted to the tax authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign parents cannot net receivables against the Vietnamese subsidiary's tax debt; any distribution must follow CIT finalisation and audited after-tax profit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts administrative fines ranging from VND 2 million to VND 15 million depending on the number of late days; late tax payment accrues interest at 0.03% per day; understated CIT can attract an additional penalty of 20% of the deficiency; intentional evasion triggers criminal prosecution under Penal Code Article 200.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for corporate shareholders. Vietnam does not impose a separate dividend withholding tax on distributions to foreign organisations. Individual shareholders are subject to personal income tax at 5% on dividends. Dividends are distributable only from audited after-tax profits after attaining balance sheet solvency and setting aside statutory reserves required by the charter and Enterprise Law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because corporate dividends are not subject to Vietnamese withholding, treaty relief is not necessary for ordinary dividend repatriation. For payments subject to source taxation such as interest or royalties, the non-resident recipient must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home jurisdiction, submit a beneficial-ownership declaration, and provide the underlying contract and payment documentation to the Vietnamese payer or tax authority. The reduced treaty rate should be applied on the basis of a valid DTA claim; if over-withheld, a refund may be claimed under the Law on Tax Administration.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Cross-border interest paid to foreign organisations: statutory Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) is 5% CIT on gross interest; VAT is 0% on loan services. Cross-border royalties paid to foreign organisations: statutory FCT is 10% CIT plus 5% VAT, producing a 15% aggregate gross-basis levy. Under Vietnamese DTAs, source-state caps commonly apply at 10% for royalties and 10% for interest; the domestic 5% interest rate prevails where the treaty cap is higher. Beneficial ownership and economic substance are strictly enforced to prevent treaty shopping.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, mandatory Local File/Master File documentation is required where annual related-party transaction turnover exceeds VND 30 billion or annual total enterprise revenue exceeds VND 50 billion. Every taxpayer with related-party transactions must attach the related-party disclosure appendix (Appendix III) to the annual CIT finalisation return even when the documentation threshold is not met. A Country-by-Country Report is required where the ultimate parent's consolidated group revenue reaches VND 18,000 billion or the foreign parent jurisdiction applies a CbCR threshold satisfied by the group.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations equivalent to the UAE; however, the General Anti-Avoidance Rule and beneficial-ownership provisions in every Vietnamese DTA operate as an economic-substance doctrine. A factoring company must maintain genuine physical presence, competent employees, substantive board oversight, capital at risk, arm's-length decision-making, and a valid State Bank of Vietnam licence if engaged in receivables factoring. A shell company lacking business substance will be denied treaty benefits and exposed to domestic CIT recharacterisation, penalties and potential criminal tax charges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting factoring fee income, reverse-factoring discounts or late-payment charges; using forged input VAT invoices to inflate deductions; booking fictitious losses; disguising cross-border intragroup payments as non-taxable disbursements; failing to declare Vietnam-source interest and royalty income to the competent tax office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penal Code Article 200: tax evasion from VND 100 million or more is punishable by a fine of VND 100 million to VND 4.5 billion and/or imprisonment from 6 months to 7 years. Administrative consequences include full collection of evaded tax, late-payment interest at 0.03% per day and a 20% deficiency penalty; serious cases can also carry supplementary fines and prohibition from holding management positions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives and chief accountants who sign false returns face criminal prosecution, travel bans, asset freezes, civil restitution and disqualification from corporate management upon conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Providing accounts-receivable factoring, reverse factoring or supply-chain finance to unrelated third parties without obtaining a finance-company or credit-institution licence from the State Bank of Vietnam; systematically holding or disbursing client funds as a middleman; structuring factoring as a trade-payables scheme to evade banking regulation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unauthorised banking and credit activity may be administratively fined up to VND 3 billion per violation under Decree 88/2019/ND-CP; illegal banking operations are criminally sanctionable under Penal Code Article 203, with fines up to VND 3 billion and imprisonment up to 5 years. Underlying factoring agreements may be declared void, leaving the offshore investor without enforceable security.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who design or approve unlicensed factoring are personally prosecuted, may be ordered to disgorge unlawful fees, face travel bans during investigation, and are barred from future financial-sector management.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Documentation Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using an offshore affiliate as a factoring master-contractor with artificially reduced fee margins; paying excessive guarantee, interest or service fees to the foreign parent; failing to prepare Local File/Master File above VND 30 billion related-party turnover or VND 50 billion annual revenue; failing to submit Appendix III; maintaining persistent Vietnamese losses while the MNE group is profitable; lacking a benchmarking study for intercompany pricing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vietnam tax authorities may re-assess intercompany transactions at arm's length, impose additional CIT, apply a 20% penalty on the under-declared tax and charge 0.03% daily late-payment interest. Non-production of TP documentation or the related-party appendix leads to administrative fines; fraudulent TP manipulation can be escalated to criminal tax-evasion proceedings under Article 200.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute intercompany agreements and TP documentation knowable as sham face personal tax liability to the extent of the shortfall, civil recovery, travel restrictions and imprisonment if criminal intent is established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance Failure in Factoring
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Factoring fictitious, stale or deliberately over-invoiced receivables to transfer value; failing to conduct customer due diligence on invoice debtors and beneficial owners; ignoring structured payments through SWIFT or escrow accounts; knowingly facilitating circular payments through shell counterparties; failing to file suspicious transaction reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative sanctions under Vietnam's Law on AML (2023) for due-diligence or reporting breaches reach hundreds of millions of VND per violation; criminal money laundering under Penal Code Article 324 carries imprisonment up to 10 years, pecuniary fines, confiscation of laundered assets and revocation of operating licences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: AML compliance officers and directors who knowingly permit money movement through factoring structures are personally criminally liable, subject to travel bans, civil restitution and a permanent prohibition from directing financial institutions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Treaty Shopping / Shell Company Abuse Without Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Inserting a Hong Kong, Singapore or Mauritius shell entity as a shareholder-lender or royalty owner solely to invoke a favourable DTA; submitting Tax Residency Certificates while the recipient has no employment, premises, decisionmaking or capital-at-risk; transferring profits as deductible royalties/interest rather than taxed dividend distributions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vietnam will deny DTA benefits and apply domestic statutory rates: 5% FCT on interest and 15% aggregate FCT on royalties; the adjustment attracts a 20% deficiency penalty and 0.03% daily interest. False document submission constitutes tax fraud and may be prosecuted; the foreign shell can also be reported to the treaty partner's tax authorities for bilateral administrative assistance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly structure and sign sham shell arrangements are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and penalties, face travel bans during tax collection, and may be prosecuted for tax evasion where economic substance is falsely certified.
